name: add_query
description: Add a query; it gets the next free id (q1, q2, …).

name: remove_query
description: Remove a query and the expectations that name it.

name: reorder_queries
description: Move a query to a position (0 is first).

name: add_sample
description: Add a sample message, written as tdata JSON (arrays as [[…]]); it gets the next free id (s1, s2, …).

name: set_sample
description: Replace a sample's message, written as tdata JSON. The summary says if it doesn't decode.

name: reorder_samples
description: Move a sample to a position (0 is first).

name: set_expectation
description: Say whether a query should match a sample: match, no-match, or none to clear it.

name: grid
description: Every sample × query: whether the query matches, what is expected and whether that passes.

name: run
description: A query's solutions on a sample: each output (tdata JSON) and its bindings. query is a query id, or tq text to try without saving.

name: sample_shape
description: The tq paths present in a sample's message, each with the kinds found there.
